The '''Gungan Scout Camp''' was located on the [[Western Great Grass Plains]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], near the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Composed of several [[Tent/Legends|tents]], the small camp was used by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Broma Lak]] of the [[Azure Cabal]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to this camp to recover an old satchel. The satchel had last been seen during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and had now been spotted in the possession of a devious-looking [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] Gungan. The spacer attacked the Ankura and killed him to acquire information about the satchel's whereabouts.

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Scout Camp appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to the ''Galaxies''{{'s}} closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
